Subject: Selwyn Kitchen Co - Quote Request

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Selwyn Kitchen Co! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I do have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary cooking operations and what type of kitchen equipment is in use?
- Are there any automatic fire suppression systems (e.g., Ansul system) installed over cooking areas?
- What are the building construction details (frame, masonry, etc.)?
- Is the location sprinklered?

Once I have these details, I should be able to turn around a competitive quote quickly for the January 4th effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
